title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
Job Title: Customer Service Administrator
Location: Huddersfield (on-site)
Salary: £26,125 basic + bonus and shift allowance (up to £28,195)
Job Type: Full-time 37.5 hours per week

Shift Pattern: 4 on 4 off Rotating early and lates

  • 2x shifts are earlies (5:30am to 4:30pm) and 2x lates (10am to 9pm)


Loom Talent is recruiting a Customer Service Administrator for a specialist transport and logistics business. You'll be based at their Huddersfield control centre, supporting the planning, dispatch and resource teams.

What you'll be doing:

  • Handling customer queries by phone, email and SMS, investigating and resolving complaints and keeping a clear record of how each one was resolved
  • Using the planning and CRM systems to find information, input data and reconcile products loaded against products delivered, investigating any discrepancies
  • Supporting the Resource Managers with stakeholder communications and maintaining the resource system and working with the Control Centre analyst team on management information
  • Reviewing agency drivers' hours submissions and once authorised, raising, sending and tracking purchase orders, including for driver medicals, random drug and alcohol tests and external training providers
  • Planning periodic driver training (annual refreshers, defensive driving) and arranging ADR renewals, keeping the driver capability matrix up to date
  • Providing general admin support, such as collating overtime availability across locations and producing summary plans for field managers and Driver Training Instructors


What we're looking for:

  • A customer service and admin background
  • High attention to detail
  • Planning, ATOSS or PO systems experience is a bonus


Hours:

  • 2x shifts are earlies (5:30am to 4:30pm) and 2x lates (10am to 9pm)
  • 37.5 hours per week on either pattern


To apply, or for a confidential conversation, contact Kieran Hayes at Loom Talent,
